intro: Emirati culture keeps Bedouin and seafaring traditions alive alongside an international, modern lifestyle.

chapters.title: Traditions
text: Falconry, camel racing, Arabic coffee with dates and the majlis, a sitting room where people meet and talk, are part of daily life. Men often wear the white kandura and women the black abaya.

chapters.title: Museums and food
text: The Louvre Abu Dhabi and the Museum of the Future are landmarks. Machboos (spiced rice with meat) and luqaimat (sweet dumplings) are traditional foods.
